colorScheme.description: Night chart only. :root declares color-scheme: dark and the page sets meta color-scheme dark; there is no light mode and no prefers-color-scheme switch.

fonts.role: The product's voice: titles, headings, body, labels, buttons, chart ticks and marker numbers.
Data: feed times, evidence keys and values, code, the digest text.
Every name from outside: domains (defanged) and, through .device, device names.

title.purpose: Page titles and the login heading; one per page.

figure.purpose: Live figures beside the Live chart.

headline.purpose: Section headings above blocks and inside panels; the enlarged chart's title.

subhead.purpose: Headings inside panels and the period list; side-panel headings on a finding's page.

lead.purpose: The sentence under a title, a finding's summary, the current decision.

body.purpose: Tables, prose, controls, the chart readout. Weight 420 for light-on-dark.

label.purpose: Table headers, filter and fact labels, the live pill; buttons at 620; meta at 400 to 450.

data-mono.purpose: Feed times at 12px; evidence, code and digest text at body size.

outside-name.purpose: Every domain, set italic, defanged, escaped and never a link.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Panels and table wrappers on the ground.

shadows.name: login-lift
shadows.purpose: The single card on the bare rail ground (login, errors).

shadows.name: hairline-stroke
shadows.purpose: Stroke round the decided-finding legend key; not depth.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for every settle: correction reveal, fresh wash, ring, tick, dialog, minute bars.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: A new feed row opening its own height.

motion.name: colour-change
motion.purpose: Background, border, colour and press transitions on buttons, inputs, links, rail links, rows and segments.

motion.name: feed-open
motion.value: 340ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); max-height 0 and zero padding/border to var(--row-max)
motion.purpose: A new feed row opens its own space so the rows below glide down.

motion.name: feed-appear
motion.value: 560ms ease-out; from opacity 0, translateY(-4px), surface-3 background
motion.purpose: A new feed row fades in from a lit background while it opens.

motion.name: feed-trim
motion.purpose: Rows past the feed's limit are removed once the new rows have opened.

motion.name: fresh
motion.value: 2400ms ease-out; magenta-wash held 0 to 25%, then transparent
motion.purpose: A finding newly arrived in the Needs a decision table.

motion.name: correction-reveal
motion.purpose: A decision is inked left to right onto the row htmx just swapped in.

motion.name: ring
motion.value: 900ms ease-out; 2px ok ring from scale 0.5 opacity 0.8 to scale 1.6 opacity 0
motion.purpose: The live dot pings on arriving queries, at most every 4000ms (live.js PING_MS) and never while paused.

motion.name: live-dot
motion.purpose: Live dot changes between open, connecting and paused.

motion.name: tick
motion.purpose: A changed live figure flashes once.

motion.name: minute-bars
motion.purpose: The server-drawn per-minute bars grow to their new value.

motion.name: dialog-in
motion.purpose: The enlarged chart dialog rising into place.

motion.name: chart-loading
motion.purpose: A chart refetching a finer series dims gently; the period list dims the same way while it loads.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): transitions 0.01ms; no ring; feed rows fade in over 200ms linear (feed-in-calm); correction shown at once; no dialog-in
motion.purpose: Every animation has a still form.

breakpoints.name: ultrawide
breakpoints.purpose: Overview becomes a 2:1 board (decision table and chart left; Right now, new devices and today's volumes right); Live sets feed and chart side by side; Domains shows four tables in a row; a finding's main column splits in two beside a 400px side column.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: The findings table gives its spare width to the About column (38%).

breakpoints.name: main-cap
breakpoints.purpose: Main fills a 3440px ultrawide; side padding clamp(36px, 2.4vw, 64px).

breakpoints.name: laptop-fold
breakpoints.purpose: Findings table folds its wide columns into a meta line under the domain; rail 212px; main side padding 28px.

breakpoints.name: collapse-columns
breakpoints.purpose: The Overview's side panels and the finding detail become one column; the side column stops sticking.

breakpoints.name: rail-to-topbar

breakpoints.name: phone

charts.palette: Read from CSS custom properties at mount: --allowed, --blocked, --primary (current bar), --low (usual line), --tint (usual band at 0.55), --surface (halo), --magenta and --on-magenta (open markers), --surface-3, --line-strong and --ink-2 (decided markers), --ink-3 (axis text), --line (grid).
charts.markers: Pills 18px tall, radius half the height, 12px/700 Mona Sans four-digit number, 14px horizontal padding; open findings magenta with a 50% magenta drop line, decided findings surface-3 with a strong-line stroke and ink-2 text.
charts.interaction: Range buttons; drag to zoom; Ctrl + scroll zoom; Shift + scroll or Shift + drag pan; double-click back to live; hover readout; click a bar to list that period, a marker to open its finding (or list the period when it stands for several); keyboard arrows, Shift + arrows, Home/End, + and -, 0, Enter/Space; Enlarge moves the chart into a modal dialog.
charts.density: About one bar per 6px of plot width, 60 to 480 bars (the server clamps to 24 to 480); a resize that changes this by more than a fifth fetches again.
charts.fallback: The server-drawn SVG chart stays in place until the series loads and whenever JavaScript is off.

narrative.northStar: Notices and Chart Corrections, at Night
narrative.overview:
The dashboard is a nautical chart kept current by its owner and read on a dimmed bridge display. Every finding is a numbered notice (printed as four digits, `0004`), and every triage decision is written onto the record in magenta, the way a correction is inked onto a chart: the old status struck through, the new status and the time beside it. Nothing is erased; the record only grows.

The world is night only: a deep-water navy ground, never black, with a darker rail and three layered navy surfaces above it. One navy-tinted ramp carries every neutral, line and ink. Depth-tint blue marks the usual (the usual-traffic band in the charts, selection, the span track). Magenta is scarce and means one of two things: something needs attention, or a decision was made. Severity reads as buoy-coloured tinted chips. The density is an operator's instrument: 14px body, tight tables, many figures, all tabular, read in short triage visits or glanced at from across the room while the page is left open as a live monitor.

Mona Sans is the product's own voice, set a touch wider for titles and live figures. JetBrains Mono carries data, and its italic marks every name that came from outside (a domain, a device name), so attacker-controlled text is always visibly someone else's words. The page is visibly live: new queries open their own space and settle, the status dot rings, changed numbers flash once, and the time charts follow the present until the owner zooms away.
keyCharacteristics: Night chart only (`color-scheme: dark`): navy ground, darker rail, surfaces stepping lighter as they rise.
Magenta reserved for attention (the open count, open-finding markers, a newly arrived finding) and decisions (corrections, history).
Severity as tinted buoy chips: coloured text on a dark wash of the same hue, with a matching hairline.
Mona Sans upright for the product; JetBrains Mono for data; JetBrains Mono italic for every outside name.
Tabular figures everywhere; a five-step ladder (12/14/16/18/28).
Interactive time charts (uPlot) that follow live, zoom, pan, list a period, and enlarge into a dialog.
Rounded, softly lifted panels (12px corners, a low diffuse shadow) on the navy ground.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Magenta does exactly two jobs: attention (what needs a decision) and decisions written onto the record. On a chart, an open finding's marker is magenta and a decided finding's marker is a grey pill (surface-3 with a strong-line stroke and second ink). Magenta is never a link, never a primary button, never a data series, never decoration.

rules.name: The Buoy Chip Rule
rules.body: Severity is only ever told by the five buoy hues, in order critical, high, medium, low, info, and always as a chip: buoy text on its own dark wash with its own hairline. No other colour carries severity.

rules.name: The Never Black Rule
rules.body: The darkest value is the rail navy; every neutral comes from the navy-tinted ramp. No pure black or pure grey surfaces.

rules.name: The Outside Voice Rule
rules.body: Every name that came from outside is sloped: domains in JetBrains Mono italic (always defanged, never a link), device names in italic. The product's own words are never sloped, and outside names are never upright.

rules.name: The Five Steps Rule
rules.body: Sizes are 12, 14, 16, 18 and 28, one job per step. Emphasis inside a step is weight (560 to 650), not size.

rules.name: The Night Weight Rule
rules.body: Light text on the dark ground is set one weight step heavier than it would be on paper (body 420, labels 560, buttons 620) with a touch more letter-spacing (0.005em body, 0.01em labels).

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular everywhere (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on the body); numeric columns align right.

rules.name: The Rising Surface Rule
rules.body: A surface that sits higher is lighter, never more saturated: ground, surface, surface-2, surface-3. Lift comes from tone first; the shadow only softens the ground under it.

dos: **Do** print every finding number as a four-digit notice (`0004`), in the table, the page title and the chart markers alike.
**Do** write a decision as a correction: struck old status, then new status and time, in correction magenta, and keep every past correction visible in the history.
**Do** draw open-finding markers in magenta and decided-finding markers as grey pills, on every chart.
**Do** set every outside name sloped (domains in JetBrains Mono italic, defanged; device names in italic), escaped and never as a link.
**Do** keep to the 12/14/16/18/28 ladder, the night weights (body 420, labels 560, buttons 620) and tabular figures, with numeric columns right-aligned.

**Do** let live arrivals open their own space and settle, keep fixed-height feeds fixed, and reserve room for text that changes (readouts, Show N new, Pause/Resume) so nothing under the pointer moves.
**Do** step surfaces lighter as they rise (ground, surface, surface-2, surface-3) and take every neutral from the navy ramp.
**Do** give every animation a reduced-motion form: transitions near zero, no ring, feed rows fade in over 200ms, the correction and the dialog simply appear.
**Do** serve every font, script and stylesheet from `/static/`, with no inline style attributes or inline scripts, so the strict CSP holds.
donts: **Don't** use magenta for links, primary buttons, decoration or a data series; it means attention or a decision, nothing else.
**Don't** show severity by any colour outside the five buoys, or as a solid fill instead of a tinted chip.
**Don't** set the product's own words in italics, or an outside name upright.
**Don't** use pure black or a neutral grey for any surface; the darkest value is the rail navy.
**Don't** let a new row, a refreshed table or a changed figure push the page or shift a control.
**Don't** load fonts, scripts, icons or images from outside `/static/`.
